_about: Curled tails, picked on side renders (Blender space of the optimised model: y back, z up, x = 0). curl: [y, z, radius] of the coil; base: [y, z] where it leaves the body; above_z: coil vertices are above this height, or behind rear_y. rig.py makes every vertex in the coil tail, with bones running from the base through the coil.
